title: The Turkish Deglutition Handicap Index
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test the reliability and validity of the The Turkish Deglutition Handicap Index among adult patients with swallowing disorders.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Willing to participate
* Having swallowing problems

Exclusion Criteria:

* Being under the age of 20 years, and above the age of 60 years
* Not willing to participate
* Having no swallowing problems
